data.title: Apple MacBook Pro 13 Retina Early 2015 A1502 i5 2.9GHz 8GB 512GB SSD Monterey
data.description:
This was my home desktop replacement for years and it never left the house, so the aluminum body and keyboard are in genuinely good shape. I wiped it, did a clean install of Monterey, and left it sitting on the out of box setup screen so it is ready to go for whoever ends up with it. This is also the last year Apple used the scissor switch keyboard before the butterfly generation, which is the reason a lot of people go looking for this specific model.

Model | MacBook Pro 13 inch Retina, Early 2015 (A1502, MacBookPro12,1)
Processor | Intel Core i5 2.9 GHz, the top i5 offered in this model
Memory | 8 GB
Storage | 512 GB Apple PCIe SSD, original, reports as 500.28 GB
Operating System | macOS 12 Monterey, clean install, at first time setup screen
Ports | HDMI, 2x USB 3.0, SD card reader, 2x Thunderbolt 2
Included | Laptop and a third party MagSafe 2 charger

Screen | Anti reflective coating wear, commonly called staingate. Visible, not severe, does not affect use. No dead pixels.
Battery | 1,205 cycles, reports Service Recommended. Runs at full performance on wall power. Plan on replacing it if you need to work unplugged.
Cosmetic | Rubber feet on the bottom case are missing. Body is otherwise clean.
Charger | Third party MagSafe 2, not an Apple original.
Not included | No original box or packaging materials.

All my listings ship with free shipping for your ease, none of this $30 shipping on a 1 pound item. I price my listings fairly but please feel free to make an offer.

Sold As Is.
data.condition_field:
Fully functional 13 inch Retina MacBook Pro, Early 2015, A1502. Clean install of macOS Monterey, sitting at the out of box setup screen. Original 512 GB Apple SSD and 8 GB of memory, nothing has been swapped or retrofitted.

Flaws, all honest: the anti reflective screen coating shows staingate wear, visible but not severe and it does not affect usability. No dead pixels. Battery has 1,205 cycles and reports Service Recommended, so it runs at full performance plugged in but will need replacing for untethered use. The rubber feet on the bottom case are missing. Ships with a third party MagSafe 2 charger rather than an Apple original, and there is no box or original packaging.
